summary: This note describes the General Dental Practitioner (GDP) network run by National University Centre for Oral Health, Singapore (NUCOHS), which lets patients visit a participating GDP for follow-up dental treatment. It is open to all residents of Singapore, including PRs and foreigners. Participating GDPs receive patients referred by NUCOHS and can refer complex cases back to NUCOHS. Participating partners are all CHAS-accredited clinics whose dentists are not under disciplinary orders from the Singapore Dental Council or Ministry of Health. The rest of the page is website navigation and boilerplate.
one_line: NUCOHS's General Dental Practitioner network lets Singapore residents get follow-up dental treatment at CHAS-accredited clinics.
key_facts: The General Dental Practitioner (GDP) network allows patients to visit their GDP for follow-up dental treatment.
The GDP network is applicable to all residents living in Singapore, including PRs and foreigners.
Participating GDPs will receive patients referred by NUCOHS for follow-up dental treatment.
Participating GDPs can also refer patients with more complicated management to NUCOHS.
Participating partners are all CHAS-accredited clinics.
Dentists participating in the GDP network should not be under any disciplinary orders from the Singapore Dental Council or Ministry of Health.
The page says interested parties should get in touch through a contact link to learn more about the GDP network.
The page was last updated on 4 Sep 2023.
The website is operated by National University Health System, with copyright 2024.
NUCOHS is the National University Centre for Oral Health, Singapore.
NUCOHS is one of the institutions in the National University Health System, alongside National University Hospital and Alexandra Hospital.
